name: ONTR
rootCause: The ONTR token project was drained due to a flawed onlyOwner check in the contract (accepts owner == address(0)). This allowed re-owning a renounced token. The attacker used hidden balance-grant logic to fake massive ONTR balances (no totalSupply/mint logs), dumped into the ONTR/WETH LP, and swapped out WETH for profit.

descriptions.text: The ONTR token project was drained due to a flawed onlyOwner check in the contract (accepts owner == address(0)). This allowed re-owning a renounced token. The attacker used hidden balance-grant logic to fake massive ONTR balances (no totalSupply/mint logs), dumped into the ONTR/WETH LP, and swapped out WETH for profit.

ONTR token on Ethereum Mainnet was exploited on May 28, 2026, due to a flawed onlyOwner modifier and hidden balance-inflation functions. The attacker was able to seize ownership, inflate token balances, and drain 49.48 WETH (approximately $98,300) from the ONTR/WETH liquidity pool. A custom onlyOwner modifier treated a renounced owner (owner = address(0)) as a pass-all condition, enabling any address to assume ownership and call privileged functions. Obfuscated functions allowed direct balance inflation without adjusting totalSupply or emitting events.
